title: 5.3.12 Challenges: Make it yours
description: The game is complete. Change one rule of your own: a second goal worth more, a bumper that slides, or a best score that survives a restart. Pick one, or invent one.

steps.title: Pick a rule and change it
steps.instructions: Choose one of the three challenges on the page above, or invent a rule of your own. Read the whole challenge before you start typing: each one asks you to change something the game already does, not to add a new screen.
hints: Whatever you pick, press R afterwards and check the game still starts cleanly.

steps.title: Name what you changed
steps.instructions: Write one sentence in the notes under the editor saying what your rule is and what would happen if you removed it. If you cannot say what would break, the rule may not be doing anything yet.
hints: A rule is something the game decides. 'The second goal is worth 5' is a rule; 'I added a sprite' is not.

requirements.title: A second goal is on the table
requirements.description: Either choice one or your own: more than one thing can be scored. Help: 5.3.8 (Lab: Three bumpers, three values)

requirements.title: Something on the table moves
requirements.description: A sprite is given a velocity of its own, so the table is not entirely still. Help: 5.2.13 (Reading: Forces vs Velocity)

requirements.title: The best score survives a restart
requirements.description: A second number is kept across rounds and updated when the score beats it. Help: 5.3.9 (Reading: The state of the game)
